+# MF-06: A pointwise Lipschitz lower bound for the joint spectral radius
+
+**George Stepaniants**  
+Department of Computing and Mathematical Sciences, California Institute of Technology, Pasadena, California, USA  
+12 September 2026
+
+This manuscript proves the pointwise one-sided Lipschitz lower bound for the joint spectral radius at every fixed nonempty compact complex matrix family. A product-bounded critical exterior power provides the reduction for reducible reference families whose products are unbounded. The perturbing family need not preserve any invariant subspace of the reference family.
+
+**Assistance and independent review.** Prepared with substantial assistance from Codex. A separate Codex agent independently audited the complete clarified proof and reported PASS on 12 September 2026. The [signed independent review](../../references/stepaniants-mf06-2026-09-12/REVIEW.md) identifies the exact archived source, its hypotheses, and the complete canonical scope. This is an independent informal AI-agent audit, not external human peer review or formal verification. Supplementary exact checks support finite algebraic transcription and do not replace the all-family proof.
